project.title: EnergySense AI: Db2-Powered Appliance Runtime Intelligence and Anomaly Investigation
project.short_description: An ESP32/Wokwi appliance-monitoring extension that stores telemetry in IBM Db2, detects appliance-specific operating deviations and supports explainable maintenance investigation with a LangChain tool-calling assistant.
project.category: IoT / AI / Data Engineering / Anomaly Analytics

members.name: Manuneethi Cholan D
members.role: Individual project developer: ECE prototype, API, Db2 integration and AI workflow

ibm_db2.edition: IBM Db2 for LUW (participant-configured instance; exact edition/version to be recorded after live verification)
ibm_db2.connector: ibm-db / ibm_db_dbi for relational operations; langchain-db2 DB2VS for optional vector retrieval
features_used: Relational equipment, telemetry and anomaly-event tables
Db2 vector search for maintenance knowledge (requires supported Db2 vector-search version)

ai_models: Optional ChatOpenAI model configured by the participant

implementation_status: 36 automated software tests and a 6-check SQLite API smoke test pass locally; synthetic demo replay detects and explains an anomaly. Live Db2 relational/vector operations, Streamlit runtime, sentence-transformer download, remote LLM and physical ESP32 validation remain unverified and require the participant's environment and credentials.
safety_note: The AI and server layers are advisory/read-only. Relay actuation remains with deterministic local ESP32 logic. Wokwi inputs and configured thresholds are simulation settings, not certified protection limits.
